long_biography.plain_text:
John Spearman co-founded Playback, a management-training business, with comedians Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones. His work with creative businesses also included mentoring James Razzall at Framestore. Razzall rose through the visual-effects company's ranks to lead its US advertising business, and Spearman shared his experience as the younger executive developed his own approach to leadership.

Spearman's family has longstanding connections with West Cork. He agreed to chair the West Cork History Festival's patrons ahead of its inaugural event, helping the organisers establish a programme bringing historians into conversation with an interested public.
